note: field 1 of SyncActionValue is `optional int64 timestamp`, written here as wire type 2 wrapping the legal `08 20`. protobufjs runs its generated `reader.int64()` regardless of the wire type, flattens the wrapper and reports timestamp 32; the bridge treats the mismatched field as unknown and reports {}. The validator classifies this as proto:mutation-interpretation (schema-invalid wire type), while the generator/replay target remains proto:mutation-agreement.
